verdict.rationale: Bench mentions 'secure access to your Bench account with unlimited logins' (bench-docs-20), implying multiple people can access the account, but there is no documentation of an invite flow for an external accountant/bookkeeper nor of role-scoped permissions distinguishing view vs. edit access. Missing for 10: explicit invite/collaborator feature, role-based permission levels, and any confirmation that an external (non-Bench) accountant can be granted adjust access.
